basic_details.job_title: RGSSH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for 35 Posts

content_sections.heading: RGSSH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RGSSH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RGSSH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: RGSSH Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 35 vacancies are available - 7 for Senior Resident - Anaesthesia, 2 for Senior Resident - Emergency, 1 for Senior Resident - Biochemistry, 2 for Senior Resident - Cardiology, 4 for Senior Resident - CTVS, 1 for Senior Resident - GI Medicine/Gastroenterology, 5 for Senior Resident - G.I. Surgery, 1 for Senior Resident - Microbiology, 2 for Senior Resident - Pathology, 5 for Senior Resident - Pulmonology, 4 for Senior Resident - Radiology and 1 for Senior Resident - Urology.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGSSH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Senior Resident posts at RGSSH?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 25th September 2026. Additionally, there is a rolling interview process held on the fourth Friday of every month.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post at RGSSH?
faq.answer: There are a total of 35 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident positions across various specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Residents is Rs. 15600 - 39100 Per Month, along with a Grade Pay of Rs. 6600 and NPA, falling under Level 11 of the 7th CPC (Rs. 67700-208700).

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What are the key documents required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the RGSSH office. The specific address is Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital, Delhi - 110093.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for these Senior Resident positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Senior Resident positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article for easy access.
